name: Unick Fix-A- Form and Printers
summary: Unick Fix-A-Form & Printers Ltd. provides specialized printing solutions for diverse industries such as pharmaceuticals, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), and agrochemicals. The company excels in offering advanced multi-page labeling and packaging services, incorporating features like distinctive print enhancements, practical functionalities, variable data printing, and robust anti-counterfeit and security measures. Established in 1984 by Hemen Vasa and Bhupen Vasa, the firm is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.
